question: Does the exact task-tangent top-16 M11 factor program at globally frozen gain 1.25 prospectively reproduce the writer-mediated M11 effect on two pristine v20 constructions while sparing controls?
evidence_status: Prospective confirmation. V20 text and capability were sealed before causal access; the exact factor indices, gain, metrics, and bars come from prior v18/v19 work and cannot change here.

searched: all temporal is/was M11 factor, hidden-mask, compiler, and construction-transfer records
v18 task-tangent factor result, v19 pristine confirmation, and fixed-gain retrospective calibration
all fresh-lexicon builders v1-v20 plus active board claims and canonical temporal dossier
prior_art.known_result: The task-tangent top-16 has stable direction but unscaled recovery .843 on held-out v18 A2 and .664/.658 on pristine v19 A1/A2. Retrospective global gain 1.25 moves those panels to 1.053/.828/.822 with controls <=.139; that result explicitly cannot confirm itself.
prior_art.novelty: No causal, factor, gradient, gain, or subspace outcome on v20 has been used. This is the first no-refit test of the exact 16 indices and scalar compiler on the independently capability-gated v20 constructions.

frozen_design.program: Use exactly the first 16 stored task-tangent factor indices. At writer-present versus writer-absent M11 input, sum their exact native bilinear output deltas, multiply the sum by global scalar 1.25, add it to writer-absent M11 output, and continue the unchanged downstream checkpoint.
frozen_design.target_panels: All 16 jointly capable rows in each v20 A1 and A2 panel.
frozen_design.controls: All 16 v20 P and C rows, reported separately and normalized by pooled gain-1.25 target RMS.
frozen_design.linearity_falsifier: Compare the complete downstream margin-effect vector at gain 1.25 with 1.25 times the margin-effect vector at native coefficient one. This tests finite-dose downstream curvature; it is not implied by exact linearity of the M11 output replacement.

predictions.pred_a_authority_formula_replays_hooks_f: All authorities, exact factor program, rows, gain, hook calls, formula/no-op replays, finiteness, and 32-forward price pass.
predictions.pred_b_fixed_program_recovers_both_prist: Each v20 A1/A2 gain-1.25 response has signed recovery in [.8,1.2], cosine >=.95, and direction agreement >=.875.
predictions.pred_c_program_is_construction_stable_an: A1/A2 recovery gap is <=.25 and each separate v20 P/C normalized RMS ratio is <=.25.
predictions.pred_d_finite_dose_response_is_locally_l: For each target panel, the relative L2 error between the gain-1.25 downstream margin effect and 1.25 times the gain-1 effect is <=.10.
predictions.pred_e_no_v20_fit_reorder_dose_or_postse: V20 contributes zero fitting, backwards, factor reorder, gain adjustment, threshold selection, or population selection after capability gating.

decision: A-E passing promotes a prospectively confirmed fixed-gain partial M11 factor program on v20. A recovery miss with high cosine rejects the global scalar and supports missing construction state; cosine/direction failure rejects the shared factor core; control failure rejects selectivity; curvature failure rejects the first-order compiler explanation.
